create_functional_datapipe: create a functional datapipe decorator that registers an IterDataPipe or MapDataPipe class as a named function
build_guaranteed_datapipes_determinism: build a context manager that guarantees all decorated DataPipes produce deterministic output
test_non_deterministic: test a non-deterministic decorator that raises an error when used inside guaranteed_datapipes_determinism
run_argument_validation: run argument validation on a DataPipe function to verify IterDataPipe arguments match expected type hints
review_runtime_validation: review runtime validation that checks __iter__ output instances are subtypes of the DataPipe's declared type
